actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Accepted for the class contract; a MuJoCo reset restores the model defaults (mj_resetData) and does not use a seed
inputs.name: seed

device.name: Open Duck Mini V2 (MuJoCo rough terrain, backlash)

facts.text: The package serves the card's first model, the MJCF scene playground/open_duck_mini_v2/xmls/scene_rough_terrain_backlash.xml, whose root element is '<mujoco model="Open Duck Mini V2 rough terrain scene">' and which includes open_duck_mini_v2_backlash.xml
The rough scene's floor is a geom of type hfield that uses the hfield asset assets/hfield.png with size '10 10 .01 0.1', and the floor geom's friction is 1.0
The robot model's root element is '<mujoco model="open_duck_mini_v2">'
The robot's compiler element declares angle 'radian' and meshdir 'assets'
The robot option sets iterations 1, ls_iterations 5 and eulerdamp disable, and it sets no timestep
The sts3215 default class sets joint damping 0.56, frictionloss 0.068 and armature 0.027
The sts3215 default class sets the position actuator kp 17.11, kv 0.0 and forcerange -3.23 3.23
The backlash default class limits its hinge range to -0.008726646259971648 to 0.008726646259971648 rad, commented as plus or minus 0.5 degrees
The robot base body has the free joint floating_base
The model has 14 position actuators, one for each actuated hinge joint, and every one sets inheritrange 1 and class sts3215
The left_hip_yaw hinge joint has range -0.5235987755982979 to 0.5235987755982997 rad
The left_hip_roll hinge joint has range -0.4363323129985815 to 0.43633231299858327 rad
The left_hip_pitch hinge joint has range -1.2217304763960306 to 0.5235987755982988 rad
The left_knee hinge joint has range -1.5707963267948966 to 1.5707963267948966 rad
The left_ankle hinge joint has range -1.5707963267948957 to 1.5707963267948974 rad
The neck_pitch hinge joint has range -0.3490658503988437 to 1.1344640137963364 rad
The head_pitch hinge joint has range -0.7853981633974483 to 0.7853981633974483 rad
The head_yaw hinge joint has range -2.792526803190927 to 2.792526803190927 rad
The head_roll hinge joint has range -0.523598775598218 to 0.5235987755983796 rad
The right_hip_yaw hinge joint has range -0.523598775598297 to 0.5235987755983006 rad
The right_hip_roll hinge joint has range -0.4363323129985797 to 0.43633231299858505 rad
The right_hip_pitch hinge joint has range -0.5235987755982988 to 1.2217304763960306 rad
The right_knee hinge joint has range -1.5707963267948966 to 1.5707963267948966 rad
The right_ankle hinge joint has range -1.5707963267948957 to 1.5707963267948974 rad

The sensor block names gyro, local_linvel, accelerometer, upvector, forwardvector, global_linvel, global_angvel, position, orientation, the left and right foot velocities and positions, and the left and right foot upvectors
The rough scene defines a home keyframe with a qpos list and a ctrl list; the ctrl list has the 14 actuator targets
The README documents MuJoCo inference for open_duck_mini_v2 with mujoco_infer.py
The inference script's default model path is playground/open_duck_mini_v2/xmls/scene_flat_terrain.xml

determinism.notes: MuJoCo integrates one model deterministically from one initial state; the bridge exposes no seed input and cap.world.reset.v1 restores the model defaults, so the same engine and the same control sequence repeat a trajectory, but no seed selects a different state

gaps: the fake backend is a stand-in for the mujoco library, not MuJoCo: it parses the MJCF for the joint and actuator layout and the inherited control ranges, but integrates a placeholder first-order motion of each actuated joint toward its control target, so trajectories, contacts, friction, actuator dynamics and sensors are not MuJoCo's
the stand-in loads no mesh, texture or hfield asset, so the rough terrain height field and all collision geometry are absent and no contact is resolved
MuJoCo itself was not importable where the gate ran, so no trajectory of this package was compared with the real engine
no rendering is offered and no physical Open Duck Mini V2 robot is modelled; nothing was validated against hardware
the stand-in uses MuJoCo's library default time step because the model's option element sets no timestep; the real engine uses the same default, but the value is not stated by the model text

measures.description: Declared native checkpoint. Integration profile restores the full native input vector; basic profile restores only advertised state plus actuator activation and exact native time. Neither profile certifies external callbacks, plugins, RNG or hardware fidelity.

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the integration state is kept and stays readable
